title: Remove SPYING From WINDOWS (O&O)
description:
O&O ShutUp10++ is an anti-spy tool which helps remove privacy invasive features in Windows.

No install is required and you can even enable all recommended settings in one-click (or disable everything, which can make your computer very buggy and is not recommended).

Get better control over telemetry, Cortana, ad tracking, location services, and a dozen other background connections Microsoft doesn't ask permission for.

If you're serious about OSINT, ethical hacking, or anything infosec - your own OS shouldn't be the leak. Look at Linux for significantly more privacy.

For educational purposes only.
